issues.explanation: Create and rename forms add domain errors to the error bag but render no @error block in queues.blade.php, so the user sees no inline message.
Queues::create() performs no explicit $this->authorize call and relies on CreateQueue to authorize, unlike every other mutating Queues action.
Serve::$notice is a public client-writable ?string with no Validate or Locked, so the client can set its own notice text (rendered escaped, self-only impact).
Serve::$mode declares #[Validate(in:any,priority_only,normal_only)] but callNext() and waitingTickets() never call validate(), falling back to Any via tryFrom instead.
QueuesTest covers mount-forbidden and foreign-id tamper cases but has no employee unauthorized-call test for create/rename/toggleActive/grantAccess/revokeAccess as the Livewire policy requires.

review.summary: Adds Queues and Serve Livewire pages, members tabs, navbar links, translations, routes, docs and extensive Pest tests. Requirements, authorization scoping and scope discipline are strong; nits are missing inline error display, create() delegating auth to the action, writable notice/mode hygiene, and absent employee-action unauthorized tests, so approve with nits.
